paragraphs: Rav Shmuel, son of Rabbah bar bar Chana.

He was Rabbah’s student. [Shevuot 36b](https://www.sefaria.org/Shevuot.36b.19) relates that he, Rav Acha bar Huna and Rav Yitzchak son of Rav Yehudah were studying Shevuot in Rabbah’s school. Rav Kahana met them and put a question to them. Rava bar Itai replies in [Shevuot 37a](https://www.sefaria.org/Shevuot.37a.1-4). In [Kiddushin 58a](https://www.sefaria.org/Kiddushin.58a.3-5) Mar Yehudah found Rav Yosef and Rav Shmuel son of Rabbah bar bar Chana at Rabbah’s doorway and questioned them. They could not answer. When they came to Rabbah, he told them: “Someone who disputes my views has confronted you.” Hyman considers it very likely that he is also called Rav Shmuel bar bar Chana, who objects to Rav Yosef in [Shabbat 29a](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.29a.7). In [Shabbat 59b](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.59b.7) and [Shabbat 146b](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.146b.7) he tells Rav Yosef, “You explicitly told us in Rav’s name,” etc.[^1]

notes.text: The encounter with Kahana begins at the end of 36b, and the conversation continues across the page break. The Shabbat notices give the shorter patronymic. Hyman considers it likely that they refer to the same Shmuel.
